title: 2.1.2 NLP and Expert Systems
description: Natural language processing applications, expert system architecture, heuristic rules, and the MYCIN medical system from Grade 11 ICT Section 2.1.

questions.question: What is the core focus of Natural Language Processing (NLP)?
options: Enabling computers to understand written and spoken human language
Converting assembly language mnemonics into binary machine code
Querying relational database records using structured SQL commands
Regulating alternating current power delivered to motherboard ports
questions.correctAnswer: Enabling computers to understand written and spoken human language

questions.question: Which email provider is explicitly noted for applying NLP to detect spam?
options: Yahoo
Hotmail
Proton
AOL

questions.question: Which translation platform is highlighted as being supported by NLP?
options: Google Translate
Babylon Dictionary
Oxford Lexicon
Cisco Packet Tracer

questions.question: Which voice-operated assistants are cited as practical applications of NLP?
options: Amazon Alexa and Apple Siri
Microsoft Excel and Access
Ubuntu Linux and Red Hat
Adobe Reader and Photoshop

questions.question: What task is accomplished through Sentiment Analysis in NLP?
options: Extracting social media data to determine user opinions
Forecasting atmospheric rainfall patterns from radar scans
Compressing digital video streams for live webcasts
Backing up system image files to cloud server arrays
questions.correctAnswer: Extracting social media data to determine user opinions

questions.question: How does NLP facilitate the identification of fake news online?
options: By checking news trustworthiness and source reliability
By disabling user accounts that post conflicting comments
By translating international articles into local languages
By encrypting publication archives using numeric hashes
questions.correctAnswer: By checking news trustworthiness and source reliability

questions.question: What does Text Summarization achieve when applied to academic articles?
options: Generates a concise summary of a large document automatically
Converts written paragraphs into audible spoken speech files
Calculates printer ink volume required for document binding
Splits narrative content into tabular relational matrices
questions.correctAnswer: Generates a concise summary of a large document automatically

questions.question: What are Expert Systems designed to achieve?
options: Emulate human experts to solve complex domain problems
Monitor power fluctuations across high-voltage transformers
Clean internal computer hardware components from dust
Defragment physical sectors across rotating storage drives
questions.correctAnswer: Emulate human experts to solve complex domain problems

questions.question: Which professional fields benefit significantly from expert systems?
options: Medical diagnosis, petroleum engineering, and financial investing
Textile weaving, residential plumbing, and timber carpentry
Ceramic sculpture, classical music mixing, and wall painting
Manual mail delivery, waste collection, and road masonry
questions.correctAnswer: Medical diagnosis, petroleum engineering, and financial investing

questions.question: What are the three core structural components of an expert system?
options: User Interface, Knowledge Base, and Inference Engine
Central Processor, System Memory, and Hard Storage
Language Compiler, Linker, and Bytecode Interpreter
Relational Table, Entity Attribute, and Primary Key
questions.correctAnswer: User Interface, Knowledge Base, and Inference Engine

questions.question: What is the function of the User Interface in an expert system?
options: Accepts user queries and presents system recommendations
Generates binary machine instructions for CPU execution
Formats storage partitions into contiguous file blocks
Regulates current flow between motherboard components
questions.correctAnswer: Accepts user queries and presents system recommendations

questions.question: How is domain knowledge organized within the Knowledge Base?
options: In the form of if-then-else rules holding factual and heuristic knowledge
As unindexed comma-separated strings inside plain text documents
As binary machine-code commands stored on optical compact discs
In alphabetical dictionaries listing grammatical language terms
questions.correctAnswer: In the form of if-then-else rules holding factual and heuristic knowledge

questions.question: What is heuristic knowledge in the context of expert systems?
options: Experiential or common-sense rules used by human experts
Mathematically proven theorems derived from pure calculus
Syntactical error codes emitted by language interpreters
Physical circuit diagrams etched onto silicon microchips
questions.correctAnswer: Experiential or common-sense rules used by human experts

questions.question: What role does the Inference Engine perform inside an expert system?
options: Acts as the processing brain referencing the knowledge base
Converts high-voltage alternating current into stable power
Scans incoming electronic mail for fraudulent attachments
Displays graphic images across liquid crystal mobile screens
questions.correctAnswer: Acts as the processing brain referencing the knowledge base

questions.question: What was the specific domain purpose of the famous early expert system MYCIN?
options: Identifying bacteria causing infections and recommending antibiotics
Predicting daily market stock valuation trends on Wall Street
Steering autonomous planetary rovers across rocky terrain
Translating diplomatic legal documents across spoken languages
questions.correctAnswer: Identifying bacteria causing infections and recommending antibiotics
